prompt: Recover abandoned cart sales by sending customers multiple reminder emails on a merchant-configured schedule.

intent.desiredOutcome: Recover abandoned cart sales by sending customers multiple reminder emails on a merchant-configured schedule.
intent.cronHint: Every 15–30 minutes to check if scheduled reminders are due to send
intent.qualityBrief: A good version of this app tracks abandoned carts accurately, stops sending emails as soon as a customer completes their purchase, and allows the merchant to customize both the email schedule (delays and number of follow-ups) and email content. Edge cases to handle: carts abandoned before the app was installed, customers who unsubscribe, and duplicate sends if the cron job runs multiple times. The admin page should be simple and clear—showing active tracked carts, next send times, and delivery status.
